notes.title: EVE Vanguard Early Access Release Window & Nemesis Event Announced At EVE Fanfest!
notes.notes:
At EVE Fanfest 2025, CCP Games rolled out the red carpet for new details about EVE Vanguard, including Nemesis, a new public access event, plus a release window for early access.

What would EVE Fanfest be without some big date announcements regarding EVE Online and its spinoffs? We already know that EVE Online’s newest expansion, Legion, is coming to New Eden on May 27, 2025, but Capsuleers have been waiting for juicy details regarding the MMOFPS extension of EVE Online, EVE Vanguard.

After today’s Fanfest keynote, we now know that the release window for EVE Vanguard is the summer of 2026! In just over a year, players will be able to send clones down to the surface to make their first-person shooter dreams come true in the massive universe of EVE. Vanguard has been in pre-alpha for 1.5 years, and soon, it will be in the hands of players everywhere.

notes.title: [BOUNTY] Review the changes to EVE Vanguard!
notes.notes:
[b]To celebrate the biggest Vanguard update yet, we are working with Just About to run 3 bounties so you can win rewards! [/b]

Nova charges, reworked grenades, chipsets, manufacturing, and the brand-spanking-new 9v9 Insurgency mode - this EVE Vanguard playtest is a game-changer in the truest sense of the word. To win a prize, [url=https://justabout.com/eve-online/37800/review-the-changes-to-eve-vanguard-reward]head over to Just About and tell us if those changes are for the better or the worse[/url], and what could be done to improve them.
